title: The Dig
tagline: Dig down through an endless blocky deep, find the rooms planted for you, and step through their portals.
readinessNote: Plays end to end, saves in the browser. Rooms, districts of ruins and their building styles are JSON files (sample-plants.json, districts/): CLAUDE.md gives each format field by field. This copy ships two sample rooms and one sample district; the first thing to build is your own.
buildYourOwn: Rooms with a question on a stone and a portal world behind it (theme, colours, enemies, treasure, notes); districts of ruins with texts carved on their walls and a sealed chamber; building styles for them.
controls: Keyboard and mouse, or touch (landscape) with a move stick, look, and on-screen buttons
